notes.title: Patch note v0.0.8
notes.notes:
Features

 Submap system: You can now enter some areas to explore it in depth.
 Quest HUD: a HUD now displays your current objectives.
 Monsters can now aggro depending on the level difference.
 New map areas.


Quality of life

 Energy system is now removed.
 Cards now display details about its effects.
 You can now right click to equip/unequip items.
 You can now press escape to open/close the menu.


Bug fixes

 Drag & dropping the sword in the first quest no triggers the rest of the quest correctly.
 Mark now removed when triggered.


Thanks for playing!
Don't forget to fill the feedback form. It helps a lot!

You can also join the game's Discord if you wanna talk about it, either to give your feedback, influence the development or just chat. Join us at https://discord.gg/c5NwuPEZnt

Thibaut from Rockdev
